exposure: premature rupture of membranes (PROM) in term pregnancies
cervical dilation at the initial examination
cohort: 82 pregnant women with premature rupture of membranes (PROM) at term
finding: The presence of cervical dilation at the initial examination significantly reduced the risk for progression to caesarean section.
mod_finding: The rate of cesarean section in cases with premature rupture of membranes was affected by the duration of active and latent labor, and the presence of cervical dilation at the initial examination significantly reduced the risk of cesarean section.
